explanation: Kirk gives Scotty the order in other words, but never in that exact phrase. James Doohan, who played Scotty, used it as the title of his 1996 autobiography.

claims.text: Captain Kirk never says the exact words 'Beam me up, Scotty' in the original Star Trek series.
In the series, Kirk orders Scotty to beam him up in other words.
James Doohan, who played Scotty, titled his 1996 autobiography Beam Me Up, Scotty.
